subject: Manticore
text: A Manticore can use STINGER to poison all party members.

evidence.quote: I think one is a Manticore or something like that.  He can use STINGER, which will cause all your party members to get poisoned.

subject: Wizard Ogre
text: A Wizard Ogre on a spiked square casts MUTE, SLOW, and RUSE, and can be countered with MUTE, FAST, LOCK, or AMUT.

evidence.quote: First, he used MUTE and he shut my mages up.  Then, he used SLOW and disabled my fighters.  Then, so the mages couldn't attack him, he kept using RUSE on himself...So, to fight him, use MUTE if you have it.  If he uses RUSE too much, use FAST on your fighters or cast LOCK on him.  You could also use AMUT to stop him from being a problem in the first place.

subject: Lich
text: Lich has 400 HP and casts FIR2 and ICE2, which can be mitigated with AFIR and AICE.

evidence.quote: HP-400 I think...Also, LICH will use FIR2 and ICE2, so make sure you use AFIR and AICE to help out a bit.

subject: Lich
text: FIR3 will never do more than 40-50 damage against Lich.

evidence.quote: Nintendo Power says that LICH is weak against Fire, but even FIR3 will never do more than 40-50 damage, so don't bother with that.

subject: Lich
text: SLO2 can successfully afflict Lich during the boss fight.

evidence.quote: One time, I even got SLO2 to work on LICH.  Wow, that helped immensely.

subject: Circle of Sages
text: Visiting the Circle of Sages in Crescent Lake grants the CANOE.

evidence.quote: Now it's time to talk go to the Circle of Sages.  They will tell you some semi-important information, but the real thing you're after is the CANOE.

subject: Castle of Ordeal
text: The author recommends going to the Castle of Ordeal first before Gurgu Volcano and the Ice Cave.

evidence.quote: The Castle of Ordeal is actually last in line of the plot, but I recommend going here first.

subject: Medusa
text: Medusas in the Castle of Ordeal travel in packs and can turn the whole party to stone in a round or two.

evidence.quote: There will be Medusas that travel in packs and can easily turn your whole party to stone in just a round or two.

subject: Ice Cave
text: The Ice Cave is considered the hardest cave because enemies use RUB and auto-kill attacks while the party lacks a Proring.

evidence.quote: You can do the Ice cave now if you want to, but this is the absolute hardest cave in the game, because many of the enemies use RUB and other related auto-kill attacks and you do not have a Proring at this time to prevent them.

subject: Red Gargoyle
text: Red Gargoyles appear in packs of 3-6 and repeatedly cast FIR2 for 20 to 40-50 damage, making AFIR or fleeing advisable.

evidence.quote: You will find some Red Gargoyles, these will cause you problems no matter what you do.  They cast FIR2 almost incessantly, and have pretty high attack power too.  Just use AFIR as soon as you encounter them...And, to top it off, they usually travel in packs in 3-6 and usually get the first attack.  FIR2 can do as little as 20 damage, or as much as 40-50...Just run if you see any.

subject: Fire
text: Players cannot run from the Fire monster, which only attacks and can be defeated with ICE2.

evidence.quote: Also, there is a monster called Fire.  He looks and acts much like Earth.  He can't do anything but attack, but, like Earth, he does that very well.  Fire can be a threat to your characters if they have low HP and/or defense.  You can't run, so just attack and use ICE2 if you want.

subject: Perilisk
text: Cockatrices use SQUINT to turn targets to stone, while accompanying Perilisks have an instant kill attack, and both can be defeated with ICE2.

evidence.quote: Also in the Gurgu Volcano, you will find Cockatrices, who will use SQUINT on you and turn you to stone.  There will also be Perilisks that hang out with them.  These guys will use something like squint, I forget what it's called, but it will kill you instantly.  Just use a blast of ICE2 and you will find any Cockatrices and Perilisks paying you big bucks for killing them.

subject: Gurgu Volcano
text: A Flame shield can be found on the first couple floors of Gurgu Volcano.

evidence.quote: On the first couple floors, you won't find much, except maybe a Flame shield (or is that lower?).

subject: Gurgu Volcano
text: The Giant Sword is found in Gurgu Volcano and is intended to give an edge against Giants.

evidence.quote: You will also find the Giant Sword, which is supposed to give you an edge against Giants, but most any other sword you have by this time will do much better than the Giant Sword.

subject: Gurgu Volcano
text: The Ice Sword found lower in Gurgu Volcano provides an extra boost against fire enemies.

evidence.quote: As you get lower, you will find a MUCH better weapon, the Ice Sword.  This is a Fighter or Red Mage's pride and joy.  This will be the most powerful weapon for them for a LONG time.  It seems to have an extra boost against fire enemies, but it doesn't seem at all ineffective against Ice enemies for some reason.

subject: Gurgu Volcano
text: Flame Equipment found in Gurgu Volcano provides good defense for Fighters and protects against Ice attacks.

evidence.quote: You will also find some Flame Equipment which will provide good defense overall for a Fighter and will protect against Ice attacks.

subject: Agama
text: Heading west on the bottom lava level of Gurgu Volcano leads to a candle-enclosed treasure chest preceded by a square spiked with Agama.

evidence.quote: To start, head west (left), but only if you dare.  You will find yourself in a room with candles enclosing a treasure chest.  Just before you enter this little "cage", you will find a square spiked with Agama.

subject: Agama
text: Agama on spiked squares uses HEAT for 20-30 damage, provides good Exp, and can be defeated in one round.

evidence.quote:
I guess you should note Agama also.  He can use a 
move called HEAT, which is pretty much like FIR2, except it only does about 20-
30 damage to your party.  There are a few spiked squares with Agama.  I 
recommend fighting, because he gives you some good Exp.  Plus, he has fairly low 
HP and Defense, so with a full-party attack, you should be able to knock him off 
in one round.
